title: BendRip instance
description: Per-template schema for bend. Core TemplateConfig fields (theme/global) are $ref-d from the global animations.schema.json. This template does NOT own content — it applies a folding-pages treatment to arbitrary `children` passed by the caller, so `elements[]` is unconstrained (any id) and typically empty. extras.* are extended here.

elements.description: Currently unused by bend itself — content is passed as `children` to <BendRip>. Kept in the schema for DeepConfig pipeline compatibility.

zone.description: Height of the folded region at each edge in CSS pixels

angle.description: Maximum fold angle in degrees, reached away from the scroll ends. 90 is a cube edge

rounding.description: Radius in CSS pixels of the circular arc that rounds each fold crease. 0 keeps a sharp cube edge. Clamped to the zone height

perspective.description: Perspective focal length in CSS pixels. Smaller values pinch the folded edges harder

direction.description: "out" folds the edges away from the viewer like the outside of a cube, "in" tilts them toward the viewer

ease.description: Scroll distance in CSS pixels over which an edge flattens near its scroll end
